title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you looking to join a friendly, supportive accountancy team where you can continue developing your skills, build strong client relationships and feel genuinely part of the team?

NXTGEN is pleased to be working with a well established accountancy practice that puts its people, teamwork and client relationships at the heart of what it does. This is a fantastic opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join a collaborative team where you will be supported in your development, encouraged to take on new challenges and given the opportunity to progress your career.

Why join?
- A genuinely supportive team:Work alongside approachable colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge, offer guidance and help each other succeed.
- A positive working culture: Join a team where collaboration is valued, people work together to get the job done and you will never feel like just another number.
- Career development: Benefit from ongoing guidance and mentoring from experienced senior team members, helping you develop both your technical and client management skills.
- Study support: Continue working towards your professional qualifications with support to help you achieve your long term career goals.

- Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, providing support and guidance on their accounting needs.
- Using digital accounting software, including Xero and Dext, to support efficient ways of working.
- Working closely with colleagues across the team, sharing knowledge and supporting more junior members where appropriate.
- Managing your workload effectively to ensure deadlines are met and clients receive a consistently high standard of service.

The ideal Accounts Assistant will have:
- AAT qualification or equivalent.
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice in a similar role.
- Good communication skills and the confidence to build positive relationships with clients and colleagues.
- A proactive approach, with the ability to manage your own workload while contributing to a wider team.
- A genuine interest in developing your technical knowledge and progressing within practice.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants more than just their next role. If you are looking for a welcoming team, supportive management and the chance to develop your career within a people focused accountancy practice, we would love to hear from you.

Salary Offered D.O.E

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant (Accounts Payable & Receivable)

Location: Cambridge (Outskirts)
Rate : £15.85 per hour
Job Type: Full-Time (37 hours per week)

About the Opportunity

A well-established and innovative organisation is seeking an Accounts Assistant to join its finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in finance while gaining exposure to a broad range of accounting responsibilities within a supportive and collaborative environment.

- Ensure invoices are appropriately authorised and correctly coded.

Essential

- Experience within Accounts Payable and/or Accounts Receivable.
- Experience working within a structured finance environment.
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Strong Excel and data-handling capabilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable
- Experience using Sage or a similar accounting system.
- Additional finance or accounting qualifications.

What's on Offer?
- Stable permanent opportunity within a growing organisation.
- Opportunity to support management accounting processes and develop broader finance skills.
- Collaborative and supportive team environment.
- Ongoing professional development opportunities.

title: Finance & Accounts Coordinator
description:
Finance & Accounts Coordinator

Looking for a finance role that offers more variety and responsibility than traditional accounts administration?

This is an opportunity to join an established and growing business in a broad finance position, taking responsibility for a varied range of accounting and financial administration activities.

This position will see you involved in the day-to-day financial operations of the business, covering everything from purchase and sales ledger through to reconciliations, credit control, VAT and month-end support.

It's a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across different areas of finance, takes pride in accuracy and is confident managing their own workload.

What will you be responsible for?
- Accounts Management: Handling supplier invoices, customer billing, payment applications and resolving account queries.
- Financial Control: Managing bank and credit card reconciliations, monitoring outstanding customer payments and supporting cash flow
- Project & Cost Tracking: Recording costs against jobs, monitoring material expenditure and helping maintain accurate project and stock information
- Compliance & Reporting: Dealing with CIS requirements, VAT returns and month-end activities, including journals, accruals and prepayments.

What experience will you need?

We're looking for someone with a solid grounding in accounts or finance who is comfortable working across multiple areas of a finance function.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar position.
- Good working knowledge of purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Experience with UK VAT requirements, including CIS and Domestic Reverse Charge VAT.
- Confidence completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Experience using accounting software, ideally Sage 50.
- Strong Excel skills, including the ability to work with VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables.
- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently.
- Confident communication skills when dealing with suppliers, customers and colleagues.

Qualifications & Additional Experience

An AAT Level 2 or Level 3 qualification, or someone currently studying towards AAT, would be welcomed.

Experience with ERP or MRP systems, stock control, project costing or manufacturing accounts would also be beneficial.

However, relevant practical experience and a good understanding of financial processes are equally important.

The Opportunity

You'll be joining an established business where the finance function plays an important part in supporting operational and commercial activity.

The breadth of the position offers exposure to several areas of accounting, providing an excellent opportunity for someone looking to consolidate their existing experience and continue developing their finance career.

Interested?

If you have experience across accounts or finance and are looking for a varied position where you can take ownership of a broad range of responsibilities, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Apply today for a confidential conversation.
